page.overview:
What is Nightbrother?

The Nightbrother was a modified Kom'rk-class fighter/transport, named and used by the former Sith Lord Maul during the Clone Wars and the Imperial Era. Following Maul's death at the hands of Obi-Wan Kenobi in 2 BBY, the Nightbrother was acquired by the Spectres rebel cell, where it was simply called the Gauntlet.

The Nightbrother was a customized Kom'rk-class fighter/transport of the Kryze Gauntlet ship variant. Customized with a black and red color scheme, the starfighter featured rotating wings, a large hull, and was armed with two forward and two rear laser cannons.

As the leader of the Death Watch and the rest of the Shadow Collective, Maul used the Nightbrother as his flagship, commanding his forces from the ship in battles during the Confederacy of Independent Systems' campaign against the Shadow Collective.

Many years later during the reign of the Galactic Empire, the starfighter was still in Maul's service. Maul used the Nightbrother to flee Vizsla Keep 09 after the Rebel group known as the Spectres managed to free themselves from his captivity. However, Maul was able to perform a connection with the Jedi Padawan Ezra Bridger after the two individuals combined their holocrons. Maul learned that his old enemy Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi still lived.
